channel.title: Tanzania - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Tanzania, every source cited.

item.title: Safaricom reports 1.25 billion cyberattack attempts
item.description: Kenya's leading telecom operator detected millions of daily intrusion attempts in its 2026 financial year.

item.title: Tanzanian banks partner with startups
item.description: Innovators gain access to financial systems and capital, boosting the country's growing tech sector.

item.title: Kadogosa orders construction equipment returned
item.description: Tanzania's Minister of Works ordered contractors to keep equipment on project sites.

item.title: Alute Lissu, lawyer and brother of Tundu Lissu, dies
item.description: The constitutional lawyer died early Sunday after a long illness, his family announced.

item.title: Samia inaugurates Sh700 billion government city in Dodoma
item.description: Tanzania's new administrative hub, Mtumba Government City, officially opened with modern offices and infrastructure.
